title: PG-05.1 Engine integration: merge semantics, mapping, boundary (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP05 in memev: Engine integration: merge semantics, mapping, boundary. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP05.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP01-03, WP04-01, WP04-03, WP05-02, WP05-05. Depends on contracts: SO-2.12, SO-2.13, WO-05-B. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.12 and SO-2.13: WP05-06 degrades as SO-2.12 requirement 8 says when the paid engine is absent and keeps the paid interface behind SO-2.13 requirements 3 and 4; neither is restated here. Signed vault contract WO-05-A and WO-05-C (cited by id only): foundation: the call-out boundary and the external convergence service specification; this spec cites them and does not specify them again. Signed vault contract WO-05-B (cited by id only): the paid-engine client behind a flag, off by default (draft PR #201, still open); WP05-05 is dropped from this spec because that signed contract owns it, and WP05-06 depends on it. Build layer (lead workstream decision under owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the unsigned fold (SO-A-01 to SO-A-12, SO-R-E, SO-F-01 to SO-F-13, cited by id only) is the build layer, and it overlaps this spec at SO-F-02, SO-F-06. This spec will cite those ids and keep only what the fold does not cover; trim pending fold PR (the final fold ids come in the lead's separate pull request, branch contracts/scope-one-fold-build-layer). Nothing is trimmed yet. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.title: Merge-semantics table: object classes (observations, metadata, membership, counters, task ownership, task state, contracts, approvals, external actions) to semantics, with rationale
requirements: MV-ARCH-05: Merge semantics are chosen per object class (observations, metadata, membership, counters, task ownership, task state, contracts, approvals, external actions), never one CRDT for everything. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:14; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:69; baseline 8.5)

The call-out boundary WO-05-A sends one JSON line {a, b, base} of text and expects {text} or {refuse:true}, and crdt-merge has no three-way text merge, so a provider shim maps a note to structured state (for example lines to a set); the shim lives outside the Memev core (in memev-ops or on the crdt-merge side) (source: repository analysis of 1 Nov 2026, section 5; signed vault contract WO-05-A, cited by id only)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Task ownership is a lease/claim, not a counter. Contracts and approvals are never silently merged.
